name: Vespid Dynamics Counter-Drone Electronic Warfare Kit CDEW-2
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Counter-Drone Electronic Warfare Kit CDEW-2
description: A portable electronic warfare kit designed to detect, track, and disable hostile drones through signal jamming, GPS spoofing, and direct electromagnetic pulse. The CDEW-2 includes a drone detection radar, a directional jammer that can sever the control link between a drone and its operator, a GPS spoofer that feeds false position data to cause the drone to fly to a designated capture zone, and a focused EMP emitter that can permanently disable drone electronics at up to 50 meters. Vespid sells the kit as defense against their competitors' drone platforms — and their own, for clients who want protection from all aerial threats.

specifications.info: severs control link at 500m; permanent disable

story_hooks: A CDEW-2 was used to capture a Vespid surveillance drone intact — the drone's data cache contained months of surveillance footage that Vespid claims was collected under legitimate authorization.

A modified CDEW-2 has been developed that does not disable hostile drones but instead takes control of them — the captured drones join the defender's network and can be turned against their original operator.

physical_description.visual_profile: A modular backpack-mounted electronic warfare system with three distinct functional units: a rigid upper chassis housing the detection radar and control interface, a central junction box for signal processing, and a lower emission pod containing the jammer and EMP emitter. Angular, utilitarian design with aggressive forward-swept geometry suggesting active threat detection capability.
physical_description.dimensions: Backpack form factor, approximately 60cm height × 45cm width × 25cm depth
physical_description.weight_description: 5 kg total, distributed across backpack frame with padded shoulder straps and waist stabilizers for load bearing during active operations
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite chassis with aluminum alloy heat sinks and stainless steel electromagnetic shielding
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical grey with brushed aluminum accents; mil-spec non-reflective coating on all external surfaces
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal grey primary with high-visibility warning yellow trim around the EMP emitter pod and radar aperture; amber and red indicator lights
physical_description.interface_elements: Rugged 8cm monochrome tactical display with touch-sensitive navigation pad, three physical mode selector switches (DETECT/JAM/SPOOF/PULSE), battery level indicator bar, signal strength meters, target lock confirmation button, emergency kill-switch, antenna connectors, and micro-USB charging port
distinctive_features: Phased-array radar dish (12cm diameter) mounted on articulated gimbal arm with 270-degree sweep range
Cylindrical directional jammer module with rotating emission aperture and graduated distance calibrations (0-500m markings)
Hemispherical EMP emitter pod with concentric lens array visible through clear protective cover
Heat-dissipation fins running along entire rear chassis
Modular quick-disconnect coupling points for field reconfiguration
Woven cable management harnesses routing between modules
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS corporate logo embossed on upper chassis; regulatory compliance stamps (GLMZ-EW-03 certification, Φ525,000 MSRP callout); serial number plate on rear; warning labels in tri-language format (English/Mandarin/Spanish) regarding electromagnetic emission hazards
physical_description.condition_typical: In active use: radar gimbal rotates in search pattern, status display cycles through target data, antenna ports emit faint high-frequency whine, heat sinks warm to touch after sustained operation, warning lights pulse amber during threat detection
